semantics.clock: All state transitions on rising clk edge. Inputs are sampled at that edge.
semantics.reset: Active-high asynchronous reset on rising areset; while asserted reset dominates clock and selects walking left, regardless of inputs.
semantics.initialization: No power-up state specified before reset.
semantics.outputs: Moore outputs: walking left => 1000; walking right => 0100; falling either direction => 0010; digging either direction => 0001, in walk_left,walk_right,aaah,digging order. Outputs reflect registered state.
semantics.walking: If ground=0 enter falling preserving direction; else if dig=1 enter digging preserving direction; else left walker switches on bump_left, right walker switches on bump_right. Both bumps switch current direction. Opposite-only bump has no effect.
semantics.digging: Remain digging while ground=1 independent of dig and bumps. On ground=0 enter falling preserving direction.
semantics.falling: Remain falling while ground=0. On ground=1 resume walking in saved direction, ignoring dig and bumps on landing edge.
semantics.input_changes: Input changes between clock edges do not alter outputs, except asynchronous reset.

numeric.signals: All external ports are unsigned one-bit logic.
numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, counters, overflow, rounding or saturation. Six logical states represent mode and remembered direction.

verification.oracle: Independent mode (walk/fall/dig) plus direction software-style model in self-checking testbench; compare all four outputs after every sampled edge.
verification.coverage: Exhaust all six reachable states times 16 combinations of bump_left,bump_right,ground,dig. Include simultaneous triggers, both bumps, digging persistence, landing ignoring controls, and direction retention.
verification.reset: Assert asynchronous reset away from clk edge from each mode/direction; check immediately and while held across clock.
verification.timing: Check Moore output stability when controls change before next rising clk edge. Finite compile and simulation timeouts; explicit dev_tb top with -g2012.
